Setup guide and how to use
TriSplit opens three apps side by side in columns on your Fold, and keeps them working together like split screen: drag the dividers, swap apps, rotate the screen.
It needs a few things set up once: the Shizuku app, pop-up windows, and two permissions. This guide takes you through each one; every step shows a tick when it is done.
Shizuku is a free app that lets TriSplit place and resize other apps\' windows. TriSplit cannot do this on its own; Shizuku gives it that access without rooting the phone.
Shizuku is not installed yet. Install it first, then come back here.
Turn on Developer options: Settings → About phone → Software information → tap \"Build number\" seven times.
Connect to Wi‑Fi, then in Developer options turn on \"Wireless debugging\".

First time only: in Shizuku, tap \"Pairing\" under \"Start via Wireless debugging\". In Wireless debugging, tap \"Pair device with pairing code\" and enter the six-digit code in Shizuku\'s notification.
In Shizuku, tap \"Start\". When you come back here, this step shows a tick.
Shizuku stops when the phone restarts. Then open Shizuku and tap \"Start\" again (Wi‑Fi and Wireless debugging on); no new pairing is needed.
Shizuku asks before giving any app access. Tap the button and choose \"Allow all the time\".
The three columns are pop-up windows, so the phone has to allow pop-up windows for every app. TriSplit switches the two needed developer options on for you.
The handles between the columns are drawn over the apps. Find TriSplit in the list that opens and turn \"Allow permission\" on, then come back.
While three apps are open, a notification keeps the handles running and offers Equal widths, Save as preset and Close all.
Choose three apps on TriSplit\'s screen and tap \"Launch in three columns\". A handle sits between each pair of windows:
Drag it left or right to resize the two windows next to it together.
Tap it for a button that swaps those two apps.
Double-tap it to make the columns equal again.
Long-press it to hide the handles.
From split screen: open two apps with the Edge panel and pick TriSplit as one of them, then choose the rest; it becomes three columns. Apps already on screen stay.
Going home tucks the three windows into one pop-up icon. Tap any app in it and all three come back.
Close one window and the other two move to split screen.
Save combinations as presets, add them to the home screen, or add the Quick Settings tile to reopen the last three apps.
On the front screen TriSplit only shows its settings; three columns need the main screen.
You can open this guide again from Settings at the bottom of TriSplit\'s screen.
